description: Call this when the person you act for asks what a house costs. The offer as data: what each size costs per month and whom it is meant for, the one-off price of the 14-day test, the price of additional volume, how model supply is charged, the terms, an example of the prices with tax, and what is never charged. 'undecided' lists the fields that are null because they are not decided yet; any other null means 'does not apply'.
name: pricing

amounts_are.description: 'net' if amounts exclude tax, 'gross' if they include it.

as_of.description: The date this offer was last changed.

currency.description: The currency of every amount, as an ISO code. Null if not decided.

gross_example.description: What a customer pays with tax, for one example: whom it is for, the rate, and each size with its prices after tax. An example, not an invoice. Null if the offer gives none.

country.description: The country of the example, as an ISO code of two letters.

for.description: Whom the example is for, e.g. 'a private person in Germany'.

note.description: What to keep in mind when quoting the example.

rate.description: The tax rate of the example: 0.19 means 19 percent.

sizes.description: Each size with its prices after tax, rounded to the cent.

price_per_month.description: The monthly price with tax. Null where the net price is not decided.

test_price.description: The one-off price of the test with tax. Null where there is none.

manual.description: The version of the manual; cite it in a report.

commit.description: The commit of the source this manual was built from.

generated_at.description: When this manual was built, UTC.

topics.description: How many topics the manual has.

model_supply.description: The ways a house can get a language model, and how each is charged.

name.description: The way a house gets a model.

price.description: What core.blue charges for it; 0 means nothing. Null where a rule applies instead.

price_rule.description: The rule by which it is charged, where there is no fixed price.

status.description: 'today' if this is available now, 'planned' if not yet.

note.description: What to keep in mind when quoting from this answer.

operator.description: Who operates core.blue and sends the invoice.

countries.description: The countries to choose from. Null if not decided.

provider.description: Whose data centres the machines stand in.

service_fee.description: The share added to the price of everything bought from a supplier and passed on (volume, tokens): 0.2 means 20 percent.

includes.description: What a house of this size has today.

machine.description: Cores, memory and disk of the machine. Null if not decided.

meant_for.description: Whom this size is meant for.

name.description: The name of the size; pass it to request_house.

planned.description: What is planned for this size and not built yet.

price_per_month.description: The price of a house of this size per month. Null if not decided.

runs_on.description: Where a house of this size runs.

test_price.description: The one-off price of the test of this size. Null if there is none or it is not decided.

source.description: 'manual' if this is the offer of the manual, 'operator' if the operator of this server supplied its own.

stages.description: The stages from first try to a lasting house.

billing.description: How often a lasting stage is billed; what is billed is the price_per_month of the size, plus volume.

charged.description: 'once' if the price is paid one time.

duration.description: How long the stage lasts; null if it has no end.

needs_a_person.description: Whether a person has to confirm this stage. Null if not said.

price.description: The price of the stage where it is the same for every size; 0 means free. Null where it differs by size or follows the monthly price.

price_by_size.description: The price of the stage by size, where it differs. Null otherwise.

status.description: 'today' if the stage can be had now, 'planned' if not yet.

terms.description: The commercial terms. Null if none are stated.

cancellation.description: How and when a subscription can be ended.

minimum_term.description: How long a subscription binds at least; 'none' if it does not.

tax.description: What tax comes on top of the net amounts.

undecided.description: The paths of all fields that are null because they are not decided yet. A null field that is not listed here does not apply.

volume.description: Additional data volume attached to a VM house.

applies_to.description: The sizes that can have additional volume.

max_gb.description: The largest additional volume, in gigabytes.

min_gb.description: The smallest additional volume, in gigabytes.

price_per_gb_per_month.description: What you pay per gigabyte and month: the supplier's price plus the service fee. Null if not decided.

supplier_price_per_gb_per_month.description: What the supplier charges per gigabyte and month. Null if not decided.

title: Prices
